## Feature Description

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Type

- [ ] New CUDA project
- [ ] Improvement to an existing project

## Related Project

Example:

`08. Convolution`

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this feature could be implemented.

## Why Is This Useful?

Explain how this feature would benefit students, learners, developers, or contributors.

## Additional Information

Add examples, references, screenshots, or other relevant information here.
